course.title: Acoustics and Lighting
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A production area in a factory measures 60 meters X 30 méters, and 20 lamps (08) is required to illuminate the area. If each lamp has a Lighting Design Lumen (LDL) output of 15000 lumens then find the illumination required for the factory. Where, Utilization Factor = 0.3, Lamp Maintenance Factor = 0.75.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
